name: Float UI
summary: Free open-source Tailwind CSS UI components and templates for React (copy-paste).

install.command: Open https://floatui.com/components/{slug} and copy the React + Tailwind example

gaps: Pilot catalogs 12 category pages (each ships multiple variants) — not every preview in componentsNames.ts.
Custom license (not SPDX MIT/Apache): end-product OK; no redistributing components as a library.
Vue/Svelte/HTML variants exist; catalog frameworks list them but copyCode focuses on React.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Buttons
components.summary: Responsive Tailwind button variants (primary, secondary, icon, rounded).

demo.peerNotes: Tailwind CSS required; some interactive examples use Radix primitives

copyPrompt.text: Use Float UI free open-source Tailwind React component category `Buttons` (slug `buttons`) from https://floatui.com/components/buttons. Copy-paste from the site (React/Vue/Svelte/HTML tabs). Preview sources live in https://github.com/MarsX-dev/floatui/tree/main/previewsComponents (example: FUIPrimaryButtons). No npm install — paste into your app and adjust Tailwind classes. License: Float UI Custom License (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MarsX-dev/floatui/main/LICENSE.md; also https://floatui.com/license) — unlimited end products OK; do not redistribute components as a standalone library/theme/website-builder. Pricing free.

installOverride.command: Open https://floatui.com/components/buttons and copy the React example
